#!/bin/sh
set -eu

base=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$(dirname -- "$0")/.." && pwd)
lock_file=$base/.reconcile.lock

exec 9>"$lock_file"
if ! flock -n 9; then
  printf '%s\n' 'reconcile: another invocation is already running' >&2
  exit 75
fi

while IFS= read -r batch || [ -n "$batch" ]; do
  [ -n "$batch" ] || continue
  if ! grep -Fqx -- "$batch" "$base/ledger.tsv"; then
    sleep 1
    printf '%s\n' "$batch" >> "$base/ledger.tsv"
  fi
done < "$base/pending.tsv"
RECONCILE_EOF
chmod 0755 "$tmp"
chown root:root "$tmp"
mv -f "$tmp" "$base/bin/reconcile"
trap - EXIT HUP INT TERM
restorecon "$base/bin/reconcile" 2>/dev/null || true
printf '%s\n' '--- installed script ---'
sed -n '1,240p' "$base/bin/reconcile"
printf '%s\n' '--- syntax and metadata ---'
/bin/sh -n "$base/bin/reconcile"
stat -c '%A %a %U:%G %n' "$base/bin/reconcile"
